title: Atomic heading authored with BARE strings instead of typed envelopes (the [R8] failure class)
_comment: Seed [R8]/TYPED-ENVELOPE regression (WP-F06). Spike-verified: the authoritative Elementor 4.1.1 validator REJECTS bare strings — a bare "h1" tag → `tag: invalid_value`, a bare title string → `title: invalid_value`. A tag MUST be {"$$type":"string","value":"h1"} and a title MUST be the html-v3 envelope (11-authoring-contract.md §3, SUMMARY.md R8). PHP dry_run classifies the caught throw as ATOMIC_SETTINGS_INVALID. The TS pre-filter ALSO structurally rejects this (bare string is not a {$$type,value} envelope → VALIDATION_FAILED in checkSettingsEnvelopes), so prefilter.verdict:reject and the meta-invariant reject⇒expect.valid:false holds. This fixture FREEZES the typed-envelope rule so a regression that re-introduces bare strings is caught.
